items.quote: 20:1 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 20:2 Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
items.claim: Anyone of the children of Israel or strangers sojourning in Israel who gives their seed to Molech shall be put to death by stoning
items.actor: Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel
items.action: giveth any of his seed unto Molech
